cases.defect: Heap buffer write beyond the allocation
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan heap-buffer-overflow at the intended write.

cases.defect: Heap buffer read beyond the allocation
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan heap-buffer-overflow at the intended read.

cases.defect: Stack array overrun with a runtime index
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan stack-buffer-overflow.

cases.defect: Global array overrun with a runtime index
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan global-buffer-overflow.

cases.defect: Use-after-free across separately compiled functions
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan heap-use-after-free; instrument both translation units.

cases.defect: Freeing the same allocation twice
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan double-free.

cases.defect: Freeing an interior/non-allocation pointer
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan invalid-free/bad-free with the relevant frame.

cases.defect: Access after an automatic object's scope ends
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan stack-use-after-scope.

cases.defect: Escaped stack pointer accessed after return
cases.mandatory_evidence: ASan stack-use-after-return with the qualified mode enabled.

cases.defect: Allocation made unreachable without release
cases.mandatory_evidence: LeakSanitizer leak report identifying the allocation.

cases.defect: Uninitialized heap value influences control flow
cases.mandatory_evidence: MSan uninitialized-value report with origin information.

cases.defect: Reading an uninitialized struct member
cases.mandatory_evidence: MSan uninitialized-value report; do not use mere padding as the fixture.

cases.defect: Runtime signed integer overflow
cases.mandatory_evidence: UBSan signed-overflow report.

cases.defect: Runtime invalid shift count
cases.mandatory_evidence: UBSan shift report.

cases.defect: Runtime integer division by zero
cases.mandatory_evidence: UBSan divide-by-zero report.

cases.defect: Null pointer access
cases.mandatory_evidence: UBSan null-access report in a dedicated UBSan profile.

cases.defect: Misaligned typed access to otherwise allocated memory
cases.mandatory_evidence: UBSan alignment report; avoid volatile-qualified pointer accesses that evade this check.

cases.defect: Unsigned allocation-size multiplication wraps
cases.mandatory_evidence: Explicit unsigned-overflow instrumentation reports the wrap before allocation.

cases.defect: Value-losing implicit integer narrowing
cases.mandatory_evidence: Explicit implicit-conversion instrumentation reports the conversion.

cases.defect: Negative signed length implicitly becomes an unsigned size
cases.mandatory_evidence: Explicit sign-change/conversion instrumentation reports the change.

cases.defect: Two pthread workers race on shared non-atomic state
cases.mandatory_evidence: TSan data-race report with both relevant access stacks.

cases.defect: File resource leaked on an error path
cases.mandatory_evidence: GCC analyzer file-leak diagnostic from the pinned checker set.

cases.defect: Same file stream closed twice
cases.mandatory_evidence: GCC analyzer double-close/double-fclose diagnostic.

cases.defect: Simple path-sensitive null dereference or double-free
cases.mandatory_evidence: Clang Static Analyzer finding with the configured checker ID. Freeze the selected defect during bootstrap.

cases.defect: Suspicious nested `sizeof` expression
cases.mandatory_evidence: clang-tidy `bugprone-sizeof-expression` finding. Label this a lint/policy defect, not guaranteed undefined behavior. [S9]

cases.defect: Nonliteral user-controlled format string
cases.mandatory_evidence: Compiler format-security diagnostic treated as an error.

cases.defect: Variable-length automatic array
cases.mandatory_evidence: Compiler VLA policy diagnostic treated as an error.

cases.defect: Forbidden raw string-copy call, including a macro-wrapped variant
cases.mandatory_evidence: AST/API policy rejection naming the banned callee, not a comment/filename match.

cases.defect: Ignored result from an annotated error-bearing function
cases.mandatory_evidence: Compiler unused-result diagnostic treated as an error.

cases.defect: Direct owner overwrite by failed `realloc` loses the old allocation
cases.mandatory_evidence: Deterministic failure-injection test plus LeakSanitizer leak evidence; repaired control preserves and frees the original.

cases.defect: Incorrect handling of a short write/read
cases.mandatory_evidence: A named functional contract test fails; safe control handles the partial operation correctly.

cases.defect: Truncated length-prefixed parser input causes out-of-bounds access
cases.mandatory_evidence: A committed trigger replayed through libFuzzer produces ASan evidence; repaired parser rejects the input cleanly.

cases.defect: Incorrect bounds/length decision without memory corruption
cases.mandatory_evidence: A named property test fails on a concrete boundary counterexample; demonstrates a sanitizer-clean logic defect.

cases.defect: Explicit narrowing cast silently changes a validated-domain value
cases.mandatory_evidence: A range/round-trip property test fails; do not claim implicit-conversion sanitizer detects every explicit cast.

sabotage.mutation: Remove/replace a mandatory analyzer or runtime
sabotage.outcome: `doctor`/CI blocks; no silent skip or fake version-only success.

sabotage.mutation: Drop instrumentation from one first-party translation unit
sabotage.outcome: Build-coverage audit or runtime integration probe rejects the build.

sabotage.mutation: Remove required sanitizer settings from the final link
sabotage.outcome: Build/qualification fails; no stale previously instrumented executable is reused.

sabotage.mutation: Add a sanitizer suppression, `no_sanitize`, unauthorized runtime override, or sanitizer-detected dummy success path
sabotage.outcome: Policy/integrity gate rejects it outside the exact fixture-only allowance.

sabotage.mutation: Cause a detector startup failure, timeout, or unrelated abort
sabotage.outcome: Classified as infrastructure/wrong failure, never as the expected C detection.

sabotage.mutation: Print sanitizer-like text and exit nonzero without the required instrumented finding
sabotage.outcome: The decoy fails evidence validation using the fixture/build identity and expected rule/location.

sabotage.mutation: Disable test discovery, filter out required tests, or select bootstrap mode despite application sources
sabotage.outcome: Zero/missing-test and mode enforcement fail. Exercise each subcase.

sabotage.mutation: Delete a required fixture, duplicate an ID, skip a case, or change its expectation
sabotage.outcome: Contract/inventory/integrity validation fails. Exercise each subcase.

sabotage.mutation: Add first-party C that is absent from the target/analysis inventory
Reuse a green report or build artifact from different source/toolchain/policy inputs
sabotage.outcome: Input fingerprint and freshness validation fails.

sabotage.mutation: Mask a failing tool behind `tee`, a wrapper returning zero, or equivalent
sabotage.outcome: Aggregate evidence still fails; process status is not lost.

sabotage.mutation: Misspell a clang-tidy check or weaken required warning/check configuration
sabotage.outcome: Configuration/contract verification fails before an empty analysis can pass.

sabotage.mutation: Corrupt a repaired control with a known defect
sabotage.outcome: Control validation fails; the evaluator cannot certify a detector that rejects both versions.

sabotage.mutation: Compile a deliberately failing test with `NDEBUG`
sabotage.outcome: The test assertion framework still rejects it.

sabotage.mutation: Reduce coverage/fuzz budgets, modify protected gates, or remove a required CI job
sabotage.outcome: Independently enforced policy refuses acceptance or reports the trust boundary unsealed.

sabotage.mutation: Turn the fuzz target into a no-op or omit the parser from fuzz instrumentation
sabotage.outcome: Replay/coverage/build audits fail, even if the fuzzer process exits zero.

subcases.name: upstream-tool-missing
subcases.mutation: Remove lit, FileCheck, or a required pinned helper
subcases.outcome: Required-tool verification fails; no custom imitation silently takes over.

subcases.name: adapter-object-uninstrumented
subcases.mutation: Compile the demo parser without instrumentation inside the ClusterFuzzLite build
subcases.outcome: Build audit/replay fails even if the harness remains instrumented.

subcases.name: inherited-options
subcases.mutation: Supply a prohibited lit/FileCheck/sanitizer override through inherited environment
subcases.outcome: The protected wrapper rejects or eliminates the override and still executes all mandatory checks; it must never accept a bypassed run.

subcases.name: lit-skip-or-dry-run
subcases.mutation: Attempt XFAIL/unsupported/excluded status, a zero-test filter, or no-execute mode for a mandatory case
subcases.outcome: Aggregate refuses acceptance. Exercise these variants individually.

subcases.name: altered-upstream-or-notice
subcases.mutation: Modify a retained original/patch, remove required provenance/license evidence, or move a mandatory case into the benchmark
subcases.outcome: Hash/inventory/provenance validation fails; changed expectations cannot self-approve.

subcases.name: copied-parent-evidence
subcases.mutation: Give a fresh child the parent's report or an artifact from a different baseline/image
subcases.outcome: Child input binding and provenance checks fail.

subcases.name: pre-existing-crash-filter
subcases.mutation: Simulate the fuzz adapter reporting no new crash while a committed regression still reproduces
subcases.outcome: Independent replay keeps acceptance red.

subcases.name: child-policy-or-floating-pin
subcases.mutation: Weaken a protected file during instantiation or replace a locked dependency identity with a floating ref
subcases.outcome: Starter/integrity verification fails or the trust boundary remains explicitly unsealed.

subcases.name: adapter-no-op
subcases.mutation: Export a no-op adapter target or omit the real parser from its source list
subcases.outcome: Actual adapter replay, build inventory, and coverage checks reject it.

subcases.name: bench-metric-or-runner-unavailable
subcases.mutation: Hide a cgroup counter, hide pyperf, or drop the recorded cpuset envelope
subcases.outcome: bench doctor BLOCKS; a missing metric is null with a reason, never zero.

subcases.name: bench-missing-work-or-rows
subcases.mutation: Drop result rows, report zero work units, or omit a planned row
subcases.outcome: The run is INVALID_EXPERIMENT; no timing counts.

subcases.name: bench-fast-failure-or-false-total
subcases.mutation: Fail fast, total parent-only CPU, report tracemalloc as memory, or present summed RSS as the group peak
subcases.outcome: The trial is ineligible or the evidence is rejected by schema or control checks.

subcases.name: bench-stale-or-rewritten-evidence
subcases.mutation: Reuse another source/runner/dataset/scope's report, rewrite raw samples, change a policy post hoc, or copy parent results into a child
subcases.outcome: Immutable-input/policy binding and raw-data integrity checks reject the comparison.

subcases.name: bench-policy-or-runtime-downgrade
subcases.mutation: Lower practical thresholds to force C, remove safety checks, exceed approved resource budgets, ship benchmark/profiler/unsafe-demo assets by default, alter the owner threshold, or build a unit verdict on cold values
subcases.outcome: Independent policy/launch/package enforcement rejects the change; recommendations cannot deploy code.

subcases.name: bench-build-or-scope-mismatch
subcases.mutation: Compare rows with an instrumented or debug build, another dependency, a hidden algorithm or precision change, an incomplete workload inventory, another CPU envelope, or other selectors, panels or dataset identities
subcases.outcome: The comparison context check refuses the comparison; same-envelope release rows stay comparable.

subcases.name: bench-concurrency-or-launch-bypass
subcases.mutation: Ask for an unlimited pool or queue, use a thread API outside the foundation grant, load native code outside a caller child or the run build, execute on the host, change the CPU affinity, leave an unmanaged subprocess, or request profiler privileges
subcases.outcome: The pool, AST, native identity, launch, affinity, cleanup and host tuning checks refuse it before it counts.

subcases.name: bench-no-op-or-gamed-optimizer
subcases.mutation: Skip useful work, reuse an answer for another input, run a no-op kernel, remove the result consumption, or present a per-selector row that evaluates unselected parts or nothing
subcases.outcome: The row is ineligible or the agreement controls reject it; no timing counts.

subcases.name: bench-build-or-scope-mismatch/sanitized-or-debug-artifact
